task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
answer: Final Response: iOS 17 new features (from Apple Support article 'About iOS 17 Updates', https://support.apple.com/en-us/118723): StandBy (new full-screen experience while charging), Contact Posters, Live Voicemail, NameDrop and AirDrop improvements, Journal app, Check In, improved autocorrect/keyboard (transformer-based language model), FaceTime and Messages enhancements. Compatibility verdict: iPhone 12 IS compatible with iOS 17 — the Apple Support article references 'iPhone 12 and later' as supported for iOS 17 features, so the iPhone 12 can run iOS 17.

- The compatibility verdict ("iPhone 12 IS compatible") is directly supported by the visible "(iPhone 12 and later)" annotations in Screenshot 5, which is factually correct — iPhone 12 can run iOS 17.

Both parts of the task — researching iOS 17 features on Apple Support and verifying iPhone 12 compatibility — were completed, with the compatibility conclusion backed by visible on-page evidence.
